reviews.comment: While a 1 hour class, it is a lot of work. I found it best to get it done at the beginning of each week and submit my work to the TA for feedback. There are plenty of opportunities for extra credit and if you put the effort in and do not procrastinate, the class is very manageable.

Careers in biology is such an easy biology elective credit. The assignments were very quick with the exception of one informational interview that you have to conduct. GO TO CLASS. It's only one hour per week but she takes off 25 points for each absence, so if you miss two classes unexcused you will have a B. Otherwise super sweet and SO EASY!!

Just do the assignments on time you'll be fine. This does NOT feel like a 1hr class, it takes time. The whole class is working up to a big research paper (1st draft) ~wk6 which youll revise. Advice is to be fluent the topic YOU CHOOSE to cover(can switch l8r if needed) &read the feedback. Not a hard A, just gotta lock in and write heavy once a week
